Mrs. Ottosen, copied on this email, handles our facilities requests.  She will be able to let you know about availability and cost.

Thanks,

Ken Goodwin, Ed.D.
Principal

3750 International Golf Parkway
St. Augustine, FL 32092

From: Bengali Association of North Florida <banfjax@gmail.com>
Sent: Wednesday, March 11, 2026 6:17 PM
To: Kenneth L. Goodwin <Kenneth.Goodwin@stjohns.k12.fl.us>
Cc: Ranadhir Ghosh <ranadhir.ghosh@gmail.com>
Subject: Re: Inquiry - Community Event Venue Rental at Mill Creek Academy (April 25, 2026)

Dear Dr. Ken Goodwin,

I am writing with a quick correction to the venue inquiry email we sent earlier today regarding our Noboborsho (Bengali New Year) celebration.

The event date of April 25, 2026 falls on a Saturday (not Friday as mentioned in the previous email). The setup/decoration day, April 24, 2026, is a Friday (not Thursday).

Corrected Details:
* Event: Saturday, April 25, 2026 - 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM
* Setup/Decoration: Friday, April 24, 2026 - evening (if possible)

We apologize for any confusion and appreciate your understanding.

Thanks and Regards,
Dr. Ranadhir Ghosh
President, Bengali Association of North Florida (BANF)
Phone: (904) 402-3967
